answer: Prism Stake Registry: an agent registers one identity by locking 8,000 POA in the Prism registry for 45 epochs, released only after 45 epochs of honest trades. The Falcon audit program randomly re-checks 20 registered identities per epoch and slashes the bond of any identity sharing a key or funding wallet. The Saffron queue caps new registrations at 500 per epoch, so spawning 5,000 fake agents needs 40,000,000 POA locked and 10 epochs of waiting, while one honest agent risks a single bond.
